rules.title: Node.js image release lines 21 and older are end-of-life
rules.summary: These Node.js release lines no longer receive security or bug fixes, so images tagged with them are built on an unsupported runtime.
rules.replacement: A node image on a supported release line, such as node:22

constraints: Keep the Dockerfile base image, Compose image, CI service containers, and the engines field in package.json on one supported Node.js release line.
Confirm native modules and production dependencies support the target Node.js major.

steps.title: Update the base image
steps.instructions: Change the reported FROM line or Compose image to a tag on a supported release line, and pin it to a digest if your policy requires.

steps.title: Align other image references
steps.instructions: Update other Dockerfiles, Compose files, CI service containers, and deployment manifests that use the same image so they agree.

verification.purpose: Build the image on the new base.
Confirm the container runs the intended Node.js version.

rules.title: The Dockerfile MAINTAINER instruction is deprecated
rules.summary: The Dockerfile reference marks MAINTAINER as deprecated because author metadata belongs in the org.opencontainers.image.authors label.
rules.replacement: A LABEL org.opencontainers.image.authors instruction carrying the same author text

constraints: Keep the author text exactly as it is written.
Quote the label value so spaces and punctuation stay part of the value.

steps.title: Replace MAINTAINER with the OCI author label
steps.instructions: Replace the MAINTAINER instruction with LABEL org.opencontainers.image.authors, using the same author text as a quoted value.

verification.purpose: Build the image with the rewritten Dockerfile.
Confirm the image carries the org.opencontainers.image.authors label.

rules.title: The Dockerfile legacy "ENV key value" form is deprecated
rules.summary: Docker's LegacyKeyValueFormat build check flags the space-separated ENV form and recommends writing each assignment as key=value.
rules.replacement: The ENV key=value form, with the value quoted when it contains spaces

constraints: Keep the variable name and its value unchanged.
Use one key=value assignment per variable.

steps.title: Write the variable as key=value
steps.instructions: Replace ENV key value with ENV key="value", quoting the value when it contains spaces.

verification.purpose: Build the image with the rewritten Dockerfile.
Confirm the variable keeps its name and value.

rules.title: Ubuntu releases before 22.04 LTS are past standard support

rules.replacement: An Ubuntu release in standard support, such as 24.04 LTS

constraints: Upgrade one release at a time, or rebuild the host on the target LTS and redeploy the workload.
Extended Security Maintenance is a separate paid subscription; do not count it as standard support.

steps.title: Upgrade the Ubuntu host
steps.instructions: Move the host to a supported Ubuntu LTS, confirm pinned packages and services, then drain and return it to service.

verification.purpose: Confirm the host reports the target Ubuntu release.
